subject.title: fix(agents): keep bundle LSP tool names provider-safe

question: Should bundled LSP names use this conservative 64-character collision-repair rule as the supported upgrade contract while preserving all already-valid complete names?
rationale: The implementation can enforce the rule mechanically, but maintainers must confirm whether generated policy identifiers are a stable compatibility surface and whether 64 characters is the intended common provider ceiling.

options.title: Accept the conservative contract
options.body: Merge the current rule, treating 64 characters as the common provider-safe ceiling and preserving valid existing names exactly.

options.title: Broaden the length contract
options.body: Raise the ceiling only after proving every supported provider and tool-schema path accepts larger names without policy drift.

options.title: Keep repaired names unstable
options.body: Land the repair but document unsafe and collision-derived names as runtime identifiers that operators should discover through the tool catalog.

recommendation.title: Accept the conservative contract
recommendation.body: Merge the current rule, treating 64 characters as the common provider-safe ceiling and preserving valid existing names exactly.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest merged sibling contract is the provider-safe bundled MCP naming implementation associated with this person.
